description.en-US: Ralph Robinson's English version (1551) of More's Utopia, in the old spelling of the first printing: Raphael Hythloday's account of the island of Utopia in two books.
description.pt-BR: A versão inglesa de Ralph Robinson (1551) da Utopia de More, na grafia antiga da primeira edição: o relato de Rafael Hitlodéu sobre a ilha de Utopia em dois livros.

sources.edition: A fruteful and pleasaunt worke of the beste state of a publyque weale, and of the newe yle called Vtopia (London: 1551), EEBO-TCP A07706.
sources.description: EEBO-TCP hand-keyed transcription, original spelling kept. 1031 illegible places in the source are marked […]. Raw TEI in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: St. Thomas More died in 1535; the edition is of 1551 and the TCP transcription is released to the public domain (CC0).
